findings.quote: within the forty-six years counted from his coming of age
findings.problem: ἐν τοῖς τετταράκοντα καὶ ἓξ ἔτεσιν ἀπὸ γενεᾶς = within the forty-six years from birth, i.e. before the age of forty-six; 'from his coming of age' shifts the age limit by some seventeen years.
findings.proposed_fix: before reaching the age of forty-six

units.note: [τῶν … πρεσβυτέρων] spanning into ch. 20 is an editorial deletion, not a lacuna; English rightly omits it.
The tension between 'after this they pass the cavalry' and 'now they do it beforehand' reflects the Greek's own μετὰ ταῦτα ... νῦν δὲ προτέρους; not an error.

findings.problem: ὑπὲρ τὰς μυρίας τιμώμενοι δραχμάς = rated above 10,000 drachmas. The gloss '(asses)' equates drachmas with asses; Polybius's drachma = denarius, so the figure corresponds to 100,000 asses (first census class), not 10,000.
